asset_id.description: hash key; `<location-ordinal>#<slug>` generated from name at add (e.g. 1#walk-in-fridge)

name.description: human name; the id slug derives from it

class.description: accounting asset class; carries GL-account + useful-life defaults when the depreciation rule ships

vendor.description: manufacturer/vendor (e.g. True). vendor+model keys service history and the future cross-firm failure-signature join

in_service.description: ISO date the unit entered service

warranty_expiry.description: ISO date the warranty ends; the future promise-clock reads this

status.description: operational status. retired here is operational; the disposal journal entry is a separate accounting step

owner.description: contact_id when the unit is installed-base (managed, not owned — a client's furnace). presence permanently disables the capitalized fields

cost.description: acquisition cost; presence = capitalized, and the row carries acquired_entry (no capitalized row without a journal entry)

paid_via.description: how acquisition posted: cash/payable posted Dr FIXED_ASSETS; opening references the opening balance sheet (no new entry)

acquired_entry.description: the acquisition journal entry id, or the literal 'opening'. lambda-managed

salvage.description: salvage value for the future depreciation schedule

useful_life_months.description: useful life in months for the future depreciation schedule

method.description: depreciation method hint (e.g. straight_line); a param for the future rule, never code
